title: Corner
description: Screen corner the tag hugs. It sits in the empty region osu! leaves along that edge for the ruleset (beside the osu!/catch playfield, beside the mania stage, below the taiko lane), 32 px inside it and clear of the default HUD. Bottom-right is empty in every ruleset on osu!stable. On the left of a default-skin mania stage the band is narrow: lower the scale or use a right corner.

title: Nudge right / px
description: Moves the tag from its corner for skins with a different layout; negative moves left.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2, grown from the chosen corner.

title: Backing
description: none: text floats on the game with a light shadow. scrim: a soft dark fade behind the tag. panel: a graphite 18-LAB plate.

title: Accent colour
description: map: the rank mark and avatar corners take a colour from the current beatmap's background (amber when it has none). 18-lab: always amber.

title: Show avatar
description: Loads your profile picture from a.ppy.sh, the only request this overlay makes outside vosu; your initial stands in when it cannot load. Off hides the avatar and makes no outside request.

title: Show session changes
description: Beside rank and pp: the change since this source loaded (green gains, red losses), kept per account and ruleset. Nothing shows until something changed. Reload the source to start a new session.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand mark beside your name.
